Done in Konin, on Saturday, next before the Feast of Saint Michael the Archangel, namely the 29th day of the month of September, in the Year of the Lord 1782.

On behalf of the Venerable Ląd Convent, against the Illustrious Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — a Report

Let there be seen at this place a Report on behalf of the Venerable Ląd Convent, against the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — for the Ordinary General Sessions of the Crown Tribunal of the Kingdom at Piotrków — as the copy stands in the submitted documents.
app53170koningr153-1:
Done on the estate of Trąbczyn and at the place of the corner junction, beside three visible corner mounds — namely the first, of the estate of Trąbczyn Małe, or Nowa Wieś, belonging to the Most Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław; the second, of Łukom, belonging to the Right Honourable Ścibor Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa; and the third, of the neighbouring village of Drzewce, belonging to the Reverend Ląd Convent of the Cistercian Order, as hereditary holders — corner mounds established and raised from the ground in the pine forest near the road to Pyzdry and another road running from Zagórów and Drzewce towards Chocz or Kalisz, by commission decree sanctioned by force of law by the Estates of the Realm, issued in 1775 on the 3rd of October; and approved by the post-commissarial decree of the Crown Tribunal of Piotrków, on Wednesday after the Feast of Saint Agnes, Virgin and Martyr, namely the 23rd of January in the present current year 1782, and also under the other decree specified below, which constitutes the present act — conducted on Thursday after the Feast of Saint Catherine, Virgin and Martyr, namely the 28th of November in the year of the Lord 1782.

[Translator's note: Lat. haereditariorum. The term designates the Ląd Convent as the hereditary proprietor of the Drzewce estate.]

[Translator's note: Lat. tum sub alterno inferius de actu specificando actum praesentem constituenti approbatos. The syntax is compressed. "The other decree specified below" refers to the condescensorial decree of the Boundary Surveyor's court, introduced later in the document; the corner mounds are stated to have been approved both under the Tribunal decree just cited and under that second decree.]

Before the Right Honourable Franciszek Ksawery Jasiński of Jasień, Boundary Surveyor of the Gniezno Voivodeship. Present: the Most Illustrious and Most Reverend Benedykt Woronowski, Canon of Łęczyca, Provost of Swarzędz, sworn and privileged geometer; and also the Right Honourables and Honourables: Józef Łukaszewicz, sworn General Commissioner of Greater Poland; Michał Brzeżański; Leon Maszewski;

Franciszek Liberacki; and very many other people of various rank and condition, gathered for the present act.

And also the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn, general Court Summoner of the realm, authentic and sworn, proclaiming the present act.

[Section 2 — Embedded Tribunal Decree: Piotrków, 17 October 1782]

At today's session, by virtue of a Crown Tribunal of Piotrków decree issued between the parties, of the following tenor:

Done at Piotrków in the ordinary general sessions of the Crown Tribunal, on Thursday after the Feast of Saint Hedwig, Widow and Elect, namely the 17th of October in the year [of the Lord] 1782, between: the Right Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław, plaintiff and cited, through the Right Honourable Maciej Rudnicki; the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, cited and plaintiff, personally; the Honourable Jakub Górski, Boundary Surveyor of Inowrocław, in their official capacity, through the Honourable Ignacy Ujazdowski; the Right Honourable Alojzy Orławski, Boundary Surveyor of the Dobrzyń Land, in their official capacity, [unclear] through the Honourable Ludwik Borzeski; the Most Honourable and Most Reverend Lubstowski, Abbot of the Ląd Convent, and the entire Reverend Ląd Convent, cited through the Honourable Ignacy Gzowski —

[Translator's note: Lat. anno [Domini?] 1782 — the word Domini is uncertain in the transcription.]

[Translator's note: A word or words are missing in the source before "through the Honourable Ludwik Borzeski," likely describing Orławski's mode of citation.]

concerning the condemnation objected from that side, obtained on 11 September 1780 at the field inspection held at the estate of Grab pursuant to the Tribunal decree, on the part of the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Most Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, to his advantage, for the contravention of the Tribunal decree and the production of documents:

[Translator's note: Lat. in lucro — "to his advantage/profit"; a standard legal phrase indicating the condemnation accrued to Chełmski's benefit.]

the present ordinary general session of the Crown Tribunal of Piotrków holds the Most Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, to be bound to demonstrate his right of standing, and that immediately; and since he does not demonstrate it but rather submits himself to the moderation of the court, thereby constituting his right of standing for himself, the same Most Honourable Prusimski, for the condemnation objected against him,

[Translator's note: Lat. judicio praesenti ordinarium generale Tribunalis Regni Petricoviensis... censet — the syntax is strained; judicio praesenti functions either as a dative of reference or as an unusual nominative. The sense is that the present court pronounces this ruling.]

shall pay fourfold fourteen Polish marks — half to the objecting party and half to the court — immediately, under the customary penalty to be extended from the register of penalties; and sentences the same Most Honourable Prusimski to have right of standing, and orders the parties to proceed to pleading.

During the pleading, the resolution of the matters alleged by the Right Honourable Chełmski — namely of a certain manifest as if made before the records of the Poznań Municipal Court, and of its production — being meanwhile suspended, the court orders the parties to introduce their case.

In the formal pleading, the citations of the parties being as follows: namely those of the Most Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław, against the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, and Jan Orławski, Boundary Surveyor of the Dobrzyń Land, and also the Most Honourable and Most Reverend Benedykt Lubstowski, Abbot of the Ląd Convent of the Cistercian Order, and the entire [convent] —

[Translator's note: The document uses "Orławski" here and "Orłowski" in later passages. "Orławski" is followed at first occurrence; the variant is recorded.]

all prejudicial acts being annulled, for the determination of the mounds in accordance with the line placed on the map by the prior act of the court, and a field inspection to be assigned for the purposes of the erection of the aforementioned mounds; and the restriction of prejudicial acts, but the legitimate acts being adjudged as inviolable; the extension of penalties imposed against the Right Honourable Chełmski for the discrepant sentence obtained, and against the Ląd Convent on account of a manifest lodged in the records against the post-commissarial decree —

in Konin on the 18th of September.

On the opposing side, citations of the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Most Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, and also the Right Honourable Jakub Górski, Boundary Surveyor of Inowrocław: the act of the Inowrocław field office being annulled, and one olęder left on the estate of Łukom in accordance with the resolution of the prior decree of that court, for the marking of the wall boundary between the estates of Łukom

and Trąbczyn; and for the production of a certain manifest as if made before the records of the Poznań Municipal Court against the decree of the Gniezno Municipal Court office; the extension of penalties both against the Most Honourable Prusimski and against the field office; and the cassation of an illegally obtained process —

in Konin on Monday after the Feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross.

A second [citation] of the same substance, at the castle of Radziejów; all recognised in the present year.

In the settling of the controversies of the parties: namely of the Most Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław, who stands by the decree issued between himself and the Right Honourable Chełmski by the prior court on Wednesday after the Feast of Saint Agnes, Virgin and Martyr in the present year —

[a decree] determining the raising of the wall mounds between the estates of Łukom and Trąbczyn in accordance with the line placed on the map, from the centre of the corner mounds to the centre of the axial mounds; and assigning the recovery of possession of the olędry handed over by the Right Honourable Chełmski on his own account, except for one olęder left to the Right Honourable Chełmski; and having the force of immovability from the bind of the 1776 constitution; and by virtue of the decree inserted above, the recovery of possession [gap in source] having followed on the 6th of March at the estate of the olędry, as attested by the act of the field inspection office;

[Translator's note: A word or words are missing in the source before "having followed on the 6th of March."]

alleging that the re-demarcation of the aforementioned estates, after the cutting of the line in accordance with the line placed on the map, and its verification made by the Boundary Surveyors' field inspection offices of Inowrocław and Dobrzyń on 27 May in the present year, had not been effected on account of the discrepancy of these offices, arising from the matter as if the olęder estate adjudicated to the Right Honourable Chełmski by the above-mentioned decree by the line placed on the map were in existence, and hence on account of the non-conformity of the map;

establishing nevertheless, by a judicial inspection made at his request on 23 February at the estate of Trąbczyn by the Court Summoner and two noblemen and recorded in the Konin court records on 10 June of the present year, that the existence of this olęder, or his ground by the burning of the same, is on the side of the Right Honourable Chełmski; and explaining that the map, with regard to the line placed upon it by the decree, is verified, as the aforementioned discordant acts show; and concluding that the execution of the aforementioned decree of that court in the raising of wall mounds, in accordance with the line so often mentioned, should be effected, notwithstanding the recovery of possession of Martin Hunt on behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski by the above-mentioned field inspection act; and demanding that penalties on account of the litigation brought against the aforementioned decree — both against the Right Honourable Chełmski and against the Reverend Ląd Convent, on account of the manifest lodged against the said decree in the Poznań municipal court records on Wednesday after the Feast of the Nativity of Saint John the Baptist in the present year, and also against the Dobrzyń field inspection office for having produced a discrepant sentence, be extended; and that the payment of the sums adjudged by the aforementioned decree, together with penalties, be imposed for the lifting of the process; and explaining that the manifest now claimed to have been lodged by the Right Honourable Chełmski as if before the records of the Poznań Municipal Court in his name against the act of recovery of possession, and carried into the field inspection decrees as a notation, had in fact been made before the records of the Kowal Municipal Court on 27 March of the present year, and not before the Poznań court, and had been falsely noted as such in the aforementioned decrees.

On the other side, the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, alleging that one olęder had been adjudicated to him by the previously alleged decree of the prior court by the line placed on the map, and the recovery of possession thereof determined in his favour;

but showing this straight line to be unfindable on the ground on his side for completing the act of re-demarcation in accordance with the tenor of the decree noted above, through the discrepant acts of the field offices; and alleging that the referral in this point by the Dobrzyń Boundary Surveyor's office on account of the non-conformity of the map to his court had been legitimately made; and explaining that the judicial inspection of the burned farmsteads of the olęder, presented as evidence, proves nothing, from the fact that by the bind of the above-mentioned decree the olęder was adjudicated to him without any mention being made of the said burning; and demanding the execution of the whole of the said decree, with only one olęder left on his side; and demanding penalties in respect of the manifest as if made in the Poznań Municipal Court records laid down by the Most Honourable Prusimski at the field decrees and noted in them, but not existing in those same records, as the searches attest; and demanding that distinct penalties on account of the caused discrepancy, against both the Most Honourable Prusimski and the official who had ordered an improvement of the line beyond the rule of the Tribunal decree, be imposed; and finally concluding that the Ląd Convent — having withdrawn from the aforementioned manifest made against the decree, by a withdrawal made before the records of that court on the 16th of the present month by the Honourable Ignacy Gzowski in the name of the same convent — be declared exempt; and that the penalty claimed by the Most Honourable Prusimski on this point be removed —

all of which having been heard and understood.

Since it has been brought to that court's knowledge that the cause of the boundaries between the estates of Trąbczyn of the Most Honourable Prusimski on the one side, and the estates of Łukom of the Right Honourable Chełmski

on the other side, ventilated by the parties over a long period of time in various courts, had been adjudicated by a commission designated by the Estates of the Realm, which had issued two decrees discrepantly and in default; and that both parties, by force of the law of 1776, had come to that prior court by mutual agreement for the relief of the commissarial decrees issued in default and discrepantly; and that in that prior court a final decree, and by the disposition of the said law immovable, had been issued on 23 January of the present year, to the personal appearance of both parties.

By which decree, settling in the first and original suit of the boundaries, having read the many sworn inquiries conducted at various sessions of the field inspections, and drawn up both [sets of] commission [records], the corner junction of these estates of Trąbczyn and Łukom with the estates of Drzewce,

and also the axial junction of the same estates with the estates of Biskupice, had been determined and demonstrated on the map; and in this point the commissarial decree issued by the commissioners engaged on the part of the Most Honourable Prusimski had been approved; and from this corner junction of the estates of Drzewce, as the starting point, the wall of the said estates of Trąbczyn and Łukom as far as the axial junction with the estates of Biskupice, as the terminal point, had been constituted by a straight line drawn on the map by the same prior court and signed by the hands of the Most Honourable President and Marshal; and for the purposes of erecting wall mounds, and also demolishing the mounds erected by the commissioners of the Right Honourable Chełmski — both the corner mounds and the wall mounds —

and in the case of the Most Honourable Prusimski, the wall mounds only; for the axial mounds and corner mounds

erected by the commissioners of the Most Honourable Prusimski under the commissarial decree of 1775 had been approved and nothing was to be done to them; a field inspection of the courts or field offices had been assigned, and those same courts or offices had been ordered to erect wall mounds along the line placed on the map; and in the subsequent action for the recovery of possession of the olędry whom the Right Honourable Chełmski had occupied beforehand by way of a delivery of possession, a separate field inspection by the office of the Gniezno Municipal Court had been adjudged; and the recovery of possession of those olędry had been ordered to be carried out by that same office on behalf of the Most Honourable Prusimski, except for one olęder demonstrated on the map by the line on the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski; and by virtue of that same court's decree, this recovery of possession of the olędry — except for one freeborn olęder, the Freeborn Martin Hunt, who had been as if adjudicated to the Right Honourable Chełmski by the resolution of that prior court — had been carried out on behalf of the Most Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, by the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court, as attested by the act done at the olęder estate on Wednesday after the Sunday Oculi of Lent, namely the 6th of March of the present year, registered in the Konin Municipal Court on the 18th of the same month and year.

In the session of the boundary field inspection in the pine forest beside the three mounds — two, namely, of the estates of Trąbczyn and Łukom, and the third of the neighbouring estate of Drzewce — erected by force of the 1775 commission, on Monday after the Feast of the Holy and Undivided Trinity, namely the 27th of May

of the present year, assigned by that same decree — the Boundary Surveyors' field offices of Inowrocław and Dobrzyń, engaged by the parties, executing the prescription of the above-mentioned decree of that court, had ordered the sworn geometer to complete the straight line — in accordance with the line placed on the map by that court — from the centre of the corner mounds of the estates of Trąbczyn, Łukom, and Drzewce to the centre of the axial mounds of the same estates with the estates of Biskupice, for the purposes of erecting wall mounds distinguishing these estates of Trąbczyn, or Trąmpczynek, or Nowa Wieś, from the estates of Łukom; and the same straight line had been completed by the sworn geometer in accordance with the prescription of the Tribunal decree, and had been reviewed and confronted by the Boundary Surveyors' field inspection offices.

But because after this line had been made by the geometer, the freeborn olęder Martin Hunt, left to the Right Honourable Chełmski by the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court, was not found on the right side — namely on the estate adjudicated to him — on this occurrence the field inspection offices had disagreed with one another, the Dobrzyń Boundary Surveyor's office having referred this matter to the present court by its act registered in Pyzdry on 21 June.

But the Inowrocław [office] — as attested by its act registered in the Konin Municipal Court on 8 June — having declared the improvement of the line made by the geometer to conform with the line on the map, as declared by both offices, had premeditated beyond the prescription of the Tribunal decree, indeed in contradiction of the decisive line, and had instructed the geometer to make this improvement so that

the place where the olęder Jan had been at the time of the 1775 commission and the making of that map — burned four years previously — should be left on the right side on behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski; but the Right Honourable Chełmski had refused this improvement of the line; and on this occurrence the matter had come to that court.

In this regard, although the Right Honourable Chełmski, heir of the estates of Łukom with appurtenances, protecting himself by the above-mentioned decree of the prior court — for the reason that one olęder, designated by that same decree to the field inspection office for the recovery of possession, seems to have been ordered to be left to him and as if adjudicated — desires the wall boundary of his estates of Łukom with the estates of Trąbczyn to be formed such that the said olęder stands on the right side of the wall line and exists on its own estate; and having regard to that olęder decided in his favour, demands clarification or in some manner an improvement of the rule of the prior court's decree, and objects to the erroneous drafting of the map.

Since, however, it is established that sworn geometers are obliged to measure geometrically and express accurately on maps only the boundary lines of the parties, any signs found on them, and other principal ones close to those same lines, and also those which decrees expressly order; and that they were concerned to note only geographically any other more remote signs and also villages; and were not bound in the notation of villages to undertake an artificial measurement of how far one farmstead is from another — and similarly, as regards the matter at issue, the Most Illustrious and Most Reverend Woronowski, Canon of Łęczyca, Privileged and Sworn Geometer,

had noted only geographically the farmsteads of the olędry, situated in the middle between the parties' boundary lines, much at variance with one another, and remote; but when this map made by him — as regards the boundary lines and the principal signs — had been presented undisputably before the prior court by the Most Honourable Prusimski, that prior court, settling the disputes between the parties, having found and established the cardinal signs also demonstrating undoubted corner junction and axial junction, had placed on this map the wall boundary line from the corner junction to the axial junction, namely from centre to centre; and had pre-commissioned the same line to be executed on the ground as accurately as possible by the sworn geometer, for the erection of mounds, to the execution of the courts or Sub-chamberlain offices; but having regard to the olęder noted only geographically on the right side of the placed line — on the assumption that the same olęder would fall to the estate of Łukom by the line to be completed on the ground — for the purpose of shortening the process, an amount having been fixed by way of reckoning and a term for the recovery of possession of the olędry prefixed before the field act, so that another calculation would not afterwards arise from the possession of those same occupied olędry — had ordered this olęder to be left, to the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court designated for the recovery of possession, on behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski; but had not regarded the same olęder as a point through which the line passes.

Therefore, taking as already established the above-mentioned post-commissarial decree of the prior court, declared immovable by the positive law of 1776, and taking into account that although the farmstead of the olęder as if residing [there] appears on the map on the right side of the line, it is not found on the ground — yet the same estate on which the surface had appeared exists immovably in its place;

and the Tribunal's resolution concerning the olęder in no way can obstruct the boundary cause finally determined by the made line and the determined corner junctions and axial junctions.

And the same olęder is recognised as belonging to the Right Honourable Chełmski by no other right; and it orders the rule of that same decree to be fully fulfilled and observed.

Both acts issued by the Boundary Surveyors' field offices, noted above, being cassated, for the purposes of executing the so often mentioned decree of the prior post-commissarial court it finds a field inspection of the Most Honourable Sub-chamberlains, or of their Boundary Surveyors, to be necessary — a sworn geometer also having first been engaged — [to be drawn] from Gniezno, or from Wschowa, or from Brest Kuyavia, or from Płock, or Sieradz, or Wieluń, or Rawa, or Gostynin, or Łomża, or Czersk, or Warsaw — to be engaged within six weeks from the act of the present decree to the disputed estate of Trąbczyn and the place of the above-mentioned corner junction.

The Most Honourable Sub-chamberlain, or field Boundary Surveyor — provided that one has been engaged by any party — shall order, or he shall order, the repositioning of the map authorised by the Tribunal court, by the Most Honourable Prusimski; and with it reposited, beginning from the three corner mounds of the estates of Trąbczyn, Łukom, and Drzewce erected by the commissioners of the Most Honourable Prusimski at the act of the 1775 commission — namely from the centre of those mounds — as far as the axial junction of those same estates of Trąbczyn, Łukom, and Biskupice, they shall order, or he shall order, the sworn geometer to complete the straightest possible line in accordance with the prescription of the same Tribunal decree; and in that line

they shall erect, or he shall erect, wall mounds only, not touching the corner mounds and axial mounds.

And whatever shall remain on the right side of that line and those mounds — all of that they shall determine, or he shall determine, to serve the estate of Łukom; and whatever on the left side — all of that [to serve] the estate of Trąbczyn, or Nowa Wieś; the mounds erected in 1775 by the commissioners engaged on the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski — both corner mounds and axial mounds and wall mounds — and also the distinct wall mounds erected by the commissioners of the Most Honourable Prusimski, they shall demolish, or he shall demolish, and shall level to the ground, or shall level; and they shall determine, or he shall determine, these boundaries as to endure in perpetuity; and all of this notwithstanding any party's default or withdrawal, and no regard being had to an opposition of citations or an appeal, they shall fulfil and conclude, or he shall fulfil and conclude.

The penalty of fourteen Polish marks — to be compensated by party to party, and to the court at half by each party, under the customary penalty to be extended from the register of penalties — to be paid.

[Translator's note: Lat. Luita paena quatuordecim marcarum Polonicalium parti per partem compensanda judicio suo per medium ab utraque sub solito rigore ex registro paenalium extendendo solvenda. A standard rubric formula specifying the fourteen-mark penalty payable by each party — half to the opposing party and half to the court. Two variant forms occur later in this section: sub distincto rigore (under a distinct penalty) and with an immediacy requirement (in instanti).]

Since it is clear from the acts of the field offices that the Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt in no way stands on the right side of the line determined by the Tribunal court, and cannot belong to the Right Honourable Chełmski, yet that the Right Honourable Chełmski has possessed that same olęder until now:

Therefore, notwithstanding the act of recovery of possession noted above, issued by the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court, it ordains that the said Right Honourable Chełmski shall return and restore that same Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt to the possession of the Most Honourable Prusimski

within six weeks from the act of the present decree, to the present commissioner of the Greater Poland Voivodeship to be engaged by the Most Honourable Prusimski; and rather that same Honourable Commissioner shall transfer and release that same olęder to the Most Honourable Prusimski into actual possession at a calculated reckoning; the Right Honourable Chełmski being subject, in case of contravention, to outlawry to be published before that same Honourable Commissioner.

[Translator's note: Lat. praeciso calculo — "at a calculated/exact reckoning," implying the transfer is to be made after an accounting of revenues has been settled.]

The penalty of fourteen Polish marks — to be compensated by party to party, and to the court at half by each party, under a distinct penalty to be extended from the register of penalties — to be paid.

And nonetheless, insisting upon the above-mentioned decree of the prior court, it sentences:

That the same Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, shall pay — without interest, as a sum from the revenue received from the olędry — the sum of six thousand one hundred and sixty-nine Polish florins and fourteen grosze; and also the discharged penalty of fourteen Polish marks, both ordered by that same decree of the prior court to be paid to the Most Honourable Prusimski; and also, on account of contravention of the same decree, a double principal surety bond; and also, for the lifting of the condemnation obtained in the satisfaction term — by the manifest made before the records of the Poznań Municipal Court on 25 June of the present year by the Most Honourable Prusimski on account of the contravention of the same decree — a single principal surety bond: all to be paid to the same Most Honourable Prusimski, or to his special plenipotentiary, on and for the 20th of January of the coming year 1783, before the office and records of the Poznań Municipal Court,

under outlawry in case of contravention, to be published concerning the manifest to be made; and to the court the half of those same surety bonds immediately under the customary penalty to be extended from the register of penalties, to be paid and genuinely counted out; and in the same term before the same records and under the same penalty, the Most Honourable Prusimski shall pay and genuinely count out to the Right Honourable Chełmski, or to his special plenipotentiary, the triple principal surety bond adjudicated to the Right Honourable Chełmski by the above-mentioned decree.

The penalty of fourteen Polish marks — to be paid to the party at the term and under the penalties noted above, and to the court the half immediately under the customary penalty — finally resolving the suspension made above by that court regarding the production, claimed by the Right Honourable Chełmski, of a certain manifest:

Since the Most Honourable Prusimski, from his personal appearance before the records of the Kowal Municipal Court on 27 March of the present year, sets forth a manifest for the cassation of the act issued by the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court on account of the delivery into possession of the Freeborn Martin Hunt's olęder improperly made to the Right Honourable Chełmski; and explains that it had been falsely noted in the field inspection act — by the office engaged on his part — that the same manifest had been made before the records of the Poznań Municipal Court, and not before the Kowal court. Therefore it declares the same Most Honourable Prusimski

free from any further alleged production.

Since, moreover, the Boundary Surveyors' field inspection offices — and namely the Right Honourable Górski, Boundary Surveyor of Inowrocław, engaged on the part of the Most Honourable Prusimski — are found to have presumed to improve for the geometer the line placed on the map by the prior court and determined by the Tribunal decree, beyond the intent and prescription of that Tribunal decree; and it having been established by the transactions on that day and act, as law requires, that the above-mentioned manifest had not been recorded in his act — it therefore decrees him to be subject to penalty.

That, for the discharge of the foregoing, he shall enter the upper tower of Radziejów castle on and for the Monday after Invocavit Sunday of the coming year, and shall continue and complete his session there, without interruption, for the space of one week; and upon leaving the tower shall pay and genuinely count out a double principal surety bond to the Right Honourable Chełmski or his plenipotentiary before the same records of the Radziejów Municipal Court — under outlawry in case of contravention, both as regards the tower session and the payment of the surety bonds, to be published concerning the manifest to be made; and to the court a single principal surety bond under the customary penalty to be extended from the register of penalties; or rather the Most Honourable Prusimski, as his official, shall stand surety for the same Right Honourable Górski in the payment of the surety bonds adjudicated both to the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski and to the treasury of the court, at the term and under the penalties and before the records noted above. And the Right Honourable Orławski, Boundary Surveyor of Dobrzyń,

engaged on the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski, for the improper referral of the present cause to his court and for withdrawing from the execution of the Tribunal decree, and for raising a certain doubt as to the line placed by the Tribunal decree: shall pay to the Most Honourable Prusimski or his plenipotentiary, at the term and before the records and under the penalties noted above, a double principal surety bond, and to the court a single one, under the accustomed penalty to be extended from the register of penalties; or likewise the Right Honourable Chełmski shall stand surety for the same Right Honourable Orławski in the payment of those same marks — both [those] adjudicated to the Most Honourable Prusimski and those to be brought to the treasury of the court — under similar penalties before the said records and at the same term and under the same penalty.

Finally, as regards the penalties claimed by the Most Honourable Prusimski against the Reverend Ląd Convent in respect of the above-mentioned post-commissarial Tribunal decree, through a manifest of accusation:

Since that same manifest made before the records of the Poznań Municipal Court on Wednesday after the Feast of the Nativity of Saint John the Baptist, namely 26 June of the present year, by the Reverend Brother Thesselinus Małachowski attests only a certain diligence and does not accuse the same Tribunal decree; and the withdrawal from it by a separate manifest made before the records of that court on the 16th of the present month by the Honourable Ignacy Gzowski in the name of the same convent, is set forth — therefore it declares the same Reverend Ląd Convent free

from the claimed penalty, and pronounces this by force of the present decree.

Antoni Siemiątkowski, Land Court Notary of the Sieradz Voivodeship, Deputy of the Crown Tribunal, and Acting Notary of the Greater Poland Voivodeship. By his own hand.

Borzysławski, by his own hand; read by Ordęga.

[Section 3 — Bridge Clause and Commencement of Field Execution]

Encompassing and narrating the above-mentioned [matters], falling and arriving precisely on today's date.

[Translator's note: Lat. Praemissa in se complectentem, et enarrantem praecise in diem hodiernam cadenti, et devenienti — a formulaic bridge clause linking the embedded Tribunal decree to the present field actum.]

The court of the Boundary Surveyor's field office of the Gniezno Voivodeship, by virtue of the Piotrków Crown Tribunal decree recently enrolled above, descended to the ground among the aforementioned estates described in the act, the Tribunal decree being encompassed [within it].

And there, having established its jurisdiction — the peace and security of judicial acts being forewarned and guarded by the voice of the general Court Summoner of the realm, expressed by name at the head of the book — on account of the approaching evening, it adjourned its act to the following day, the 29th of November, and ordered the same general Court Summoner of the realm to proclaim it.

Then after the proclaimed act, the field office proceeding to the estate of Trąbczyn through the forest road, the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, riding the same road, requested that the office record his personal appearance so that he not be bound by a process; which inscription the office promised to the Right Honourable Chełmski should he appear the next day. And on the following day, namely the 29th of November, having resumed its jurisdiction there, it ordered the parties to be called for the inscription of

their appearance.

They having been called — and namely the Most Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław, plaintiff and defendant, appearing personally — and even notwithstanding the default of the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, as precluded by the Tribunal decree — urging the execution of the decree, the execution of which has been pre-commissioned to the judgement of this office:

The court of the present field office of the Gniezno Voivodeship — having declared that the appearance of the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, is to be noted should he arrive, but his present absence not being attended to — fulfilling the rule prescribed by the forenamed Tribunal decree, first of all compels the same Most Honourable Prusimski of Kolno, Starost of Niszczewice, to the immediate repositing of the map drawn up at the act of the 1775 commission, ratified by the post-commissarial Tribunal decree; and the Most Honourable Prusimski immediately reposited the said map with the line drawn by the Tribunal court beginning from the corner mounds of the estates of Trąbczyn, Łukomia, and Drzewce, extending to the axial mounds of those same estates of Trąbczyn and Łukom and Biskupice, and on one side signed by the hand of the Most Honourable and Most Reverend Sebastian Sierakowski, Count, Canon of Kraków Cathedral, Knight of Saint Stanisław, President; and on the other by the hand of the Most Honourable Ksawery Nałęcz Kęszycki, Castellan

of Gniezno, Marshal of the Crown Tribunal, as aforesaid subscribed; the court, having found satisfaction on this point, proceeding by the tenor of the Tribunal decree to the geometer engaged by the Most Honourable Prusimski, namely the Most Illustrious and Most Reverend Benedykt Woronowski, Canon of Łęczyca, by whom the above-mentioned map was drawn:

to form the straightest possible line in accordance with the prescription of the post-commissarial Tribunal decree — the present court intimates.

The aforesaid Most Illustrious and Most Reverend geometer formed the line — also prepared in the previous field inspection act, which had not been effected on account of the discrepancy of the field offices, by the driving of rods into the ground — and filled in certain missing rods in the cut line. The court of the present field office descended to the review of the said line and its confrontation with the reposited map; having reviewed it, since it is brought to that court's knowledge that the said line from the corner junction to the axial junction has been formed in the straightest possible manner in accordance with the intent of the post-commissarial Tribunal decree:

Therefore, executing the intent of the said Piotrków Crown Tribunal decree at the present time, it declares that it proceeds to the raising or erection of mounds — and in the boggy places to the driving-in of stakes — in the line designated by the Tribunal court. Finally, evening approaching that same day, it ordered its act to be proclaimed to the following day; and likewise on the 30th of November — namely Saturday, that being the very

feast of Saint Andrew the Apostle — having resumed its jurisdiction; and the Most Honourable and Most Reverend Benedykt Lubstowski, Abbot, and also the Reverend Ląd Convent of the Sacred Cistercian Order, having been cited, appearing in person through the Religious and Very Reverend Paweł Wybieralski, Prior, in his own name and in the name of the Most Honourable Abbot and the Reverend Convent; but the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, still absent — the court of the field office, executing the sentence delivered the previous day, commenced the erection of mounds.

Beginning indeed from the centre of the corner mounds, in the act of specification, [with] the straight line formed, at a distance of ten pręty — each [mound] comprising eight and a half łokcie — [they erected] the first wall mound, or guardian of the corner junction.

[Section 4 — Mound-Erection Record]

Day 1: 30 November 1782

The 1st [wall mound] — from which, proceeding along the same line, extended geometrically toward the south, at a distance of 20 pręty, a similar 2nd; after it at a similar distance:

The 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th — from which [i.e., from the 8th mound], entering into the boggy place called stawisko, densely overgrown with various trees: the cut line at a distance of ten pręty on the edge of that same marshy ground, in place of a mound, [he drove] alder stake the 1st; from which at a similar distance of ten pręty, oak stake the 2nd; then again oak:

[Translator's note: Lat. palum quaercinum alterum demum quercinum — "oak stake the 2nd; then [also] oak." Demum functions as a continuative particle. The full sequence of stake types is: 1 alder, 2 oak, 3–5 alder, 6 oak, 7–9 alder, 10–11 oak, 12–15 alder, 16 oak, 17 alder, 18 oak (Day 1); 19 oak, 20 alder, 21 oak, 22 alder, 23 oak, 24 alder, 25 oak, 26 alder, 27 oak, 28–31 alder at marsh edge (Day 2).]

The 3rd, 4th, 5th — again alder; the 6th — again oak; the 7th, 8th, 9th — then alder; the 10th and 11th — oak; the 12th, 13th, 14th, 15th — alder; the 16th — oak; the 17th — alder;

the 18th — oak.

The 18th having been driven in, the court of the present office ordered its jurisdiction to be proclaimed for the 2nd of December.

Day 2: 2 December 1782

On that day arriving: oak stake the 19th; from which, in a higher place, or ground and estate accustomed to be ploughed, in place of a stake, wall mound the 9th; from which again in a boggy place at a similar distance, alder stake

the 20th; from which oak the 21st; again alder the 22nd; then oak the 23rd; after it alder the 24th; oak the 25th; likewise alder the 26th; the 27th — oak;

the 28th, 29th, 30th, 31st — at the edge of the muddy ground, alder — all notched in four directions, he caused to be driven in.

[Translator's note: Lat. omnes in quatuor partes obsecatos — "all notched in four directions." Stakes were notched in four directions as a standard practice to distinguish them as legal boundary markers.]

From the 31st stake, leaving those same boggy places and entering into the high pine forest, and crossing the road from the village of Łumowo — as the people say — running to the Trąbczyn olędry, at a distance of ten pręty from the last-mentioned stake, in the same line, not deviating in anything whatsoever: again wall mound the 10th; from which at a distance of twenty pręty, the 11th, the 12th, the 13th — around the hilly place; after it, on the other side of that same hilly place, the 14th — and on that same day the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, appearing personally, in whose presence the court of the present office [erected] the 15th, 16th, then the 17th and 18th — at the equal distance described above — where, evening approaching, it ordered its act likewise to be proclaimed to the following day, namely

the 3rd of December, by the general Court Summoner of the realm.

Day 3: 3 December 1782

And again on that same following day, jurisdiction having been resumed, proceeding to the continuation of the erection of mounds — in this same line and at a similar distance: the 19th, 20th, 21st, 22nd, 23rd, 24th, 25th, 26th, 27th, 28th, 29th, 30th, 31st, 32nd, 33rd, 34th, 35th, 36th, 37th, 38th, 39th, 40th — at the equal distance set out above; from which at a distance of fifteen pręty, in a place showing signs of moisture, the 41st — this being at a distance of twelve and a half pręty from the centre of the axial mounds of those same estates of Trąbczyn, Łukom, and Biskupice — those [axial mounds] being left untouched —

all in the high pine forest, each comprising six square łokcie, newly raised from the ground with the placement of metallic signs — namely into each one: five stones in the sign of the Holy Cross, pieces of burned brick, broken glass, and charcoal.

And [the court] made known that whatever remains on the right side of that line and the recently erected mounds — all of that is to serve the estate of Łukom; and whatever on the left side — all of that [is to serve] the estate of Trąbczyn or Nowa Wieś; and determined these boundaries as to endure in perpetuity.

Demolition of Prior Mounds

And so, after the foregoing had been completed, it proceeded to the demolition of the mounds — both those erected in 1775 by the commissioners engaged on the part of Chełmski, and also the distinct wall mounds erected by the commissioners

of the Most Honourable Prusimski — in accordance with the prescription of the Piotrków Crown Tribunal decree by whose authority the present act is carried out; and first of all ordered the demolition of the mounds erected as above by the commissioners engaged on the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski — both corner mounds and axial mounds and also wall mounds — and likewise those erected on the part of the Most Honourable Prusimski by the commissioners: the wall mounds only; and ordered the stakes to be extracted from the ground, and the metallic signs [placed in the mounds] in the customary manner to be extracted from those same mounds; and declared the said mounds, levelled to the ground, as null and void.

And having fulfilled everything committed to it by the Tribunal decree enrolled above, it concluded the force of the present act, no one contradicting.

Franciszek Ksawery Rawicz Jasiński of Jasień, Boundary Surveyor of the Gniezno Voivodeship. By his own hand.

[Section 5 — Registration and Presentation of the Condescensorial Decree]

The Honourable Leon Maszewski, appearing in person at the office and present records of the Konin Municipal Court in the name of the party whose interest it concerns, presented to the present office — to be entered in the acts and left in the original in these records — the condescensorial boundary decree issued and subscribed between the parties named below by the boundary surveyor's office of Gniezno, of the following tenor, to be inserted.

The original of the above-mentioned decree has been left here among the present records for the sake of perpetuity and sewn into them.

In Konin, Saturday on the vigil of the Feast of the Immaculate Conception of the Most Blessed Virgin Mary, namely the 7th of December in the year of the Lord 1782.
app53170koningr153-2:
[Section 6 — Condescensorial Decree: Possession of the Olęder Martin Hunt]

Done at the estate of the Trąbczyn olędry and at the house of the Freeborn Martin Hunt, on Thursday after the Feast of Saint Catherine, Virgin and Martyr, namely the 28th of November in the year of the Lord 1782.

Present: the Honourable Michał Brzeżański, Leon Maszewski, and others; and also the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn, general Court Summoner of the realm, proclaiming the present act.

The commissarial office of the Greater Poland Voivodeship, insisting upon the decree issued in the ordinary general sessions of the Crown Tribunal of Piotrków, on Thursday after the Feast of Saint Hedwig, Widow and Elect, namely the 17th of October of the present year, between the Most Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław, plaintiff and defendant, and also the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, defendant and plaintiff, and others expressed in that same decree by their appearances — by means of which decree, after the boundary category had been decided by that same Tribunal court, in the separate category of the recovery of possession of the olęder: since it was clear from the acts of the field offices that the Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt in no way stands on the right side of the line determined by the Tribunal court, and could not belong to the Right Honourable Chełmski, and that the Right Honourable Chełmski had been possessing that same olęder until now — therefore, notwithstanding the act of recovery of possession issued by the notarial office of the Gniezno Municipal Court, it was ordained that the Right Honourable Chełmski should return and restore that same Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt to the possession of the Most Honourable Prusimski within six weeks from the act of the same decree, to the present commissioner of the Greater Poland Voivodeship to be engaged by the Most Honourable Prusimski; or rather that the same Honourable Commissioner should transfer and release that same olęder to the Most Honourable Prusimski into actual possession at a calculated reckoning — the same decree or the aforesaid category setting it out more fully —

descended today to the place described in the act at the request of the Most Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanisław; and there, having established its jurisdiction and proclaimed it through the Court Summoner, transferred and released the Freeborn olęder Martin Hunt into the actual possession of the said Most Honourable Prusimski, who was present in person at this act; and left him in peaceful possession, no one challenging, obedience to the Most Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, having been enjoined on the said Freeborn Martin Hunt — as it leaves him by force of the present act.

Józef Łukaszewicz, General Commissioner of the Greater Poland Voivodeship, by his own hand.
app53170koningr118-28:
Enrollment of a Condescensorial Boundary Decree issued between the estates of Trąbczyn and Łukom

Let there be seen at this place the Enrollment of a Condescensorial Boundary Decree between the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, and the Illustrious Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, and others — [issued] between the estates of Trąbczyn and Łukom — with the description of the boundary mounds — in the submitted documents.
app53170koningr118-29:
For the part of the Illustrious Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — Delivery of the Olęder

Let there be seen at this place, for the part of the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — the Delivery of the Honest Martin Hunt, Olęder of Trąbczyn, carried out by the Illustrious Józef Łukaszewicz, Commissioner of the Greater Poland Palatinate — as stands in the submitted documents.
app53170koningr118-26:
Done in Konin, on Saturday, the Eve of the Feast of the Immaculate Conception of the Most Blessed Virgin Mary, namely the 7th day of the month of December, in the Year of the Lord 1782.

For the part of the Illustrious Prusimski — a Report of the Judicial Site Inspection of the Felled Pine Forest

Having come in person to the present Office and Records of the Konin Municipal Court, the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of Trąbczyn, General Royal Process Server, sound [of mind], acknowledged: that he, having with him two Nobles, namely the Honourables Adam Milewski and Jan Wilgiewicz, although absent here from the court at present, but present at the time at the location of the below-written matter — at the instance and official requisition of the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanislaus, Heir of the estates of Trąbczyn with appurtenances — on the 4th day of the present month and year, had descended with the above-mentioned Nobles into the pine forest belonging to the estate of Trąbczyn; and being there in such manner, stated that he had duly seen and counted:

namely pines in the pine forest itself belonging to the estates of Trąbczyn, on the left side of the cut line, visible by the Tribunal Decree and the field [session], and marked by stakes driven into the ground — two hundred and twenty-one construction-grade [trees], cut down by the people of the estates of Łukomia, Łomowa, and other hereditary [estates] of the Right Honourable Pan Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of [uncertain: Wschowa], on the 28th day of November of the present year, during the Act of the Condescension of the two [sessions] called by the deponent himself — cut down; which timber was taken away from the aforementioned estates, except for seven [odsiemnych] logs and [uncertain: branches] lying in place.

The same Process Server, with the above-mentioned Nobles, saw and counted the above-mentioned things on the day as above, and attested that the same were done by the order and mandate of the Illustrious Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, through [the court's] acts — of which he made this his report to the present Office, requesting that the same be received from him, which he obtained.
app53170koningr118-27:
The Honourable Maszewski, in the name of the Illustrious Prusimski, against the Illustrious Chełmski — a Manifest is lodged

Having come in person to the present Office and Books of the Konin Municipal Court, the Honourable Leon Maszewski, Estate Manager of the hereditary estates of Trąbczyn with appurtenances of His Worship the Right Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — by the order of the same, the Most Honourable, his Lord, who at this time [W/U?x?ią[uncertain: g]

was unable to attend to official matters — solemnly lodges a Complaint against the Right Honourable Pan Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of the Wschowa Land, Lord and Heir of the estates of Łukomia and others, and also the Honourable Jaroszewski, [uncertain: s]ervant of his, and other perpetrators of the below-described and above-mentioned actions — in the following manner: that the Right Honourable Pan Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, although sufficiently informed by the Tribunal Decrees — first the post-commissorial [decree], the second ordering the execution of that same post-commissorial, and also the field [acts] that followed in the present year — that the Line from the corner markers of Trąbczyn, Łukom, and Drzewce to the corner of those same estates with Biskupice, drawn on the Map by the Most Serene Tribunal, and on the ground [...] and cleared by the Geometer in the presence of the Right Honourable Pan Chełmski himself, Treasurer of Wschowa, according to the prescription of the Tribunal Decree during the condescension, and marked with stakes — separates the [estates] of Trąbczyn from the [estates] of Łukomia — nevertheless, transgressing not only the above-mentioned Decrees but also the Law established in the Year One Thousand Seven Hundred and Sixty-Eight, the same Right Honourable Pan Chełmski, already after the last Tribunal Decree, in the very [Sam...z?iem] of the two condescensions commencing by its force, [sent] his people, namely: of the Honourables: Ignacy Jaroszewski, Weynerski Clerk; of the Honest and of the Industrious: Stanisław Augustyński, half-farmstead holder from Łomów; Woysko, cottager; Michał Płachetka; Ignacy Korzalik; Szymon Wyterek; Jan Wyterek; Łukasz Wyterek; Antoni Waziak; Wawrzyn also called Old Wach, father of [Antoni] Wasiak; Piotr Motylek; Wrzycka, wool-carder; Grzela Nowaczyk; Franciszek Wyterek; Stanisław Wyterek and Jakub, cottagers; Antoni Nowaczyk; Paweł Wałęsa; Kazimierz Płocha; Stanisław Wyterek and Wojciech, half-farmstead holder from the village of Łomów; Andrzej and Szymon, farmhands; Wojciech Forczpan; Jan the Watchman from Łukom; and other some fifteen with [Torami] from the wastelands belonging to the estates of Łukom — with sleighs, [uncertain: horses], oxen, axes, and other tools — fell upon the pine forest on the left side of the line directly cleared, belonging to the estates of Trąbczyn, who, having fallen upon [it], cut down a great number of pines and carried them to the estates of Łukomia — as the judicial site inspection made about this testifies — and moreover, [uncertain: na] the same people of the Right Honourable Pan Chełmski invaded the [lands of the] Trąbczyn estate, broke into the manor domain and [uncertain: u/o]

violently took away [goods/things], accosted people from Trąbczyn on the road, and committed other acts of violence as evidenced by testimony. In which matter, the Right Honourable Starost of Niszczewice being greatly wronged, [he] ordered the present Complaint to be lodged as a Manifest in the present Books — the right of improvement of this manifest being reserved.

Leon Maszewski, in the name of my lord
app536047-1:
No. 26: Between the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of the Land of Wschowa, Plaintiff, [represented] by the Honourable Józef Stablewski, [and] the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Defendant, [represented] by the Honourable Wojciech Żeromski — regarding the objected condemnation at the estate of the village of Grab, on Monday after the Feast of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary in the year 1780 — on the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski, to his advantage, for contravention of the Tribunal's Decree, obtained and published: the Court holds that a proxy is to be produced on the part of the objecting party; and since he produces one, it therefore finds the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski bound to show his right of standing; and since he does not show it, but rather submits himself to the moderation of its judgement, therefore the Court decrees that the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, upon the establishment of his right of standing, shall pay and reckon out: to the objecting party, half of the Starost's Court bail; but to the Court, two [marks], by half, forthwith, under penalty of banishment, to be published in the determination of their courts. And meanwhile the Court finds the same Illustrious Right Honourable Starost of Niszczewice to have the right of standing, and commits the matter to trial; in which trial, since the present cause, with respect to the objected acts of violence, comes to be adjudicated, the Court therefore decrees that the Parties shall conduct and dispatch Inquisitions concerning the contents of the Term of the Plaintiff Party and the manifests of both Parties, during the continuance of its court sessions, interrogatories having first been drawn up and communicated to each other, and the oath on the uncorrupted [state] of the witnesses having been taken — with a Court Summoner appointed for the pronouncing of the form of the Oath; the production of the accused comprehended within the Term of the Plaintiff Party

the Court suspends until the reading of the Inquisitions. The Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, Plaintiff, and the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, judicially rendered the Oath concerning the uncorrupted testimony of the witnesses. Both Parties dispatched the Inquisitions and deposited the same. The Court therefore betook itself to the reading of the same, from which, having been read, it is deduced:

That men, serving the household of the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski, from the estate of Trąbczyn — having strayed from the road — arrived at the deserted tract of Smoleniec, pertaining to the more principal hereditary estates of Łukom of the Right Honourable Chełmski; and there ordered that the road by which they ought to depart be shown to them; and asked the Laboriosus Jan Kłonica, a Hollander, whose village this might be? And when the same Laboriosus Kłonica reported that these very Hollanders belonged to the Right Honourable Chełmski, the Under-coachman of the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski reproached the same Hollander for lying, and struck him with a whip; and that by the Coachman too, the same Hollander was beaten with a broken pine-wood stick; and moreover that the Under-coachman immediately shouted out that he should be struck and killed; that after these things had been carried out, the same Hollander fled into an alder grove; but that the aforementioned men of the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski turned themselves toward the house of the same Hollander, and there violently seized a servant from the hill, beat him soundly, and ordered him to be led to the Tavern of Tomice; and that on the road the same servant was continually beaten by them; and that only now, on the following day, the aforesaid servant returned home; and that on this very day, to the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski, travelling along the same road, one witness complained of the above-described violence; and that the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski promised, at home, to facilitate this matter; and that these acts, moreover, carried out on the Right Honourable Chełmski's own land, had turned out to have been done violently — whether, however, they had been carried out with the knowledge or order of the Illustrious Right Honourable Prusimski?

See the continuation under No. 22.

Continuation of No. 26.

The Inquisitions explained this not at all; and likewise the same Inquisitions reported that the Coachman and the Under-coachman, the perpetrators of the above-written acts, are not found within the estate of Trąbczyn. Wherefore the Court, having taken note of the foregoing findings — since only the Laboriosi Józef the Coachman and Walenty the Under-coachman are accused, by the Inquisitions, of the violent act, but now, since the Illustrious Right Honourable Starost of Niszczewice is in no way able to produce the aforesaid Coachman and Under-coachman, and declares before his own Court that the same were not apprehended by arrest — and on that account, a Manifest having been lodged before the Records of the Konin Municipal Court, during the sitting of the present courts, with an offer of rendering a sworn clearance, he defends himself — therefore the Court decrees: that the same Illustrious Right Honourable Starost of Niszczewice, from now and from the present act, within six weeks, before the Records of the Konin Municipal Court, shall clear himself in that manner: that the arrest on the part of the Right Honourable Chełmski did not reach the Laboriosi Józef the Coachman and Walenty the Under-coachman, nor has he the means of producing the same — and this is to be published under penalty of banishment, in case of contravention, regarding the Manifest to be lodged. But the Inquisitions now conducted the Court holds and declares are to remain in the Chancellery of this place, and to be handed over to the Parties upon prior Acquittance, [by force of the present decree].
app53170koningr119-1:
On behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against His Honour Prusimski — Report

To the office and present records of the Konin Municipal Court, appearing in person, the Honest Stanisław Stachowski of the village of Łukomia, General Royal Court Summoner, being sound, recognized that he had served authentic citation letters for the Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, of the underwritten tenor as follows:

Casimir Nałęcz Raczyński of Raczyno and Matoszyn, Starost General of Greater Poland — to you, the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Distinguished Order of Saint Stanislaus, heir of the estates of Trąbczyn and others pertaining thereto, and to the Honourable Leon Maszewski, steward of those same estates — from all your estates generally and from all sums of money of every kind, had and to be had, we command: that you appear in person and peremptorily at our own next Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, at the instance of the Right Honourable Ignacy Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, heir of the estates of Łukom and others, and of the Honourable Ignacy Jaroszewski, steward of those same estates, as plaintiff — who, adhering to his documents, both manifestos made and to be made, cite you to see and hear: you, or rather you, the Honourable Leon Maszewski — as an invader of the estates — with respect to the pine forest line, assigned by the post-commissorial decree concerning the adjudication of the boundary delimitation between the estates of Trąbczyn and the estates of Łukom as marked on the map, together with the Hollandry, hereditarily reserved and left as belonging to the estates of Łukom as the plaintiff's property, and held in the plaintiff's continuous peaceful possession up to the present act now of the erection of the boundary mounds carried out under the Tribunal decree; of the oxen, wagons and axes of the plaintiff's men entering that same pine forest only for the necessary extraction of timber, who were intercepted; in respect of the said interception and invasion of the pine forest together with the working men Thomas Fryzyer, Stanisław Lokaj, Jan Wochnicki — keepers of the Trąbczyn forest — Simon Jachowski — likewise keeper of the Nowa Wieś forest — Stanisław, Józef, and Grzegorz, coachmen, and Jan Mathias, court summoner, who by the present citation are arrested in your keeping: to be adjudged deserving of condign penalties; and that distinct penalties should also be extended to you, the Right Honourable Prusimski, if the same violent acts

are found to have been carried out on your orders; notwithstanding your manifesto and site inspection illegally procured by you — these being on the contrary annulled and held for nothing — for your action in the plaintiff's role to be adjudged incompetent against you; the stationing of men by you, pretended as null, to be removed; the presumed violences by you to be held as null; the production of the men to be ordered and an inquiry to be conducted; that you be cited and respond judicially.

Given in the Kalisz Municipal Court on 10 March 1783.

In the estates of Nowa Wieś and at the farmstead located there, at the seat in the heated room, in the presence of the revenue scribe, on this present day, the contents of the present act set down and left notified.
app53170koningr119-2:
On behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski, against His Honour Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — Report

To the office and present records of the Konin Municipal Court, appearing in person, the Honest Jan Bekierski of the village of Węgierce, General Royal Court Summoner, being sound, recognized that he had served authentic citation letters for the Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, of the underwritten tenor as follows:

Casimir Nałęcz Raczyński of Raczyno and Matoszyn, Starost General of Greater Poland — to you, the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, heir of the estates of Trąbczyn and others — from all your estates generally and from all sums of money of every kind, had and to be had, we command: that you appear in person and peremptorily at our next Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, next to be held at the Kalisz Municipal Court, at the instance of the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, heir of the estates of Łukomia, Łomowa, and others, and of the Honourable Ignacy Jaroszewski, steward of those same estates,

as plaintiff — who, adhering to his manifestos made and to be made, cite you to see and hear: to be adjudged deserving of penalties in respect of the invasion of the estate of Łomowo, which belongs to the plaintiff's hereditary principal estate of Łukom, with a hunting party of men and dogs, and the perpetration therein of various violences of every kind, to be proven by full inquisition; and to be ordered to make good the damages; for which you are to be cited and respond judicially under full penalties.

Given in the Kalisz Municipal Court on 10 March 1783.

In the Hollandry pertaining to the principal estates of Trąbczyn, and in the tavern of the Honest Mathias [?]irtionius, at the table in the heated room, with his consort of the same [condition] present, on this present day, the contents of the present act set down and left notified.
app53170koningr119-3:
Done in Konin on Tuesday next after the Quadragesimal Sunday Reminiscere, being 18 March 1783.

Requisition of the Issued Citations — On behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa

To the office and present records of the Konin Municipal Court, appearing in person, the Honest Stanisław Stachowski of the village of Łukomia, General Royal Court Summoner, in the name and by special commission of the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, heir of the estates of Łukomia with its appurtenances, his principal — requested of the present office whether the relationes of two citations issued on behalf of the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, heir of the estates of Trąbczyn and others, against his requesting party's principal, for the Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, and exported to the estates of Łukomia, had been recognized before the present records by the court summoner, and whether return dates had been attached to the same — or not.

To which requisition the present office, granting it and reviewing the Protocol of Relationes from the act of Tuesday after the Feast of Saint Catherine, Virgin and Martyr, being 26 November 1782, up to the act of the present day, found within it only one relatio: under the act of Friday after the Feast of Saint Catherine, Virgin and Martyr, being 29 November of the same month and year, by the Honest Mateusz Matuszkiewicz of the village of Podbiele, General Royal Court Summoner, recognized, exported to the estates of Łukomia, and delivered bare without a return date by the present office — nothing further was found; and therefore makes public certification of the non-existence of the same.

Stanisław Stachowski, court summoner, in his own name and in the name of his principal.
app53170koningr119-4:
On behalf of His Honour Prusimski against the Right Honourable Chełmski — Report

Appearing in person, the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn, General Royal Court Summoner, being sound, recognized that he had served authentic citation letters for the Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, for the matter to be heard at the Kalisz Municipal Court — because on behalf and at the instance of the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, heir of the estates of Trąbczyn, and likewise of the Honourable Leon Maszewski and Franciszek Liberacki and others as plaintiffs, against the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, and others as cited parties — copies and certified documents to be produced at the forthcoming session, similarly issued, at the manor house of the estates of the village of Łukom, at the table in the heated room, with the cited party present, on the preceding day, preceding the present act, set down and left notified.
app53170koningr119-6:
On behalf of the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, against His Honour Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — Report

Appearing in person, the Honest Stanisław Stachowski of the village of Łukomia, General Royal Court Summoner, being sound, recognized that he had served authentic citation letters for the Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, next to be held at the Kalisz Municipal Court — on behalf and at the instance of the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, and others as plaintiffs, against the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, and others as cited parties — copies and substantive documents to be produced at the forthcoming session, similarly issued — at the estate of Nowa Wieś, in the manor farm there, on the chest in the heated room, with the lady of the household present, on this present day, the contents of the present act set down and left notified.
app53170koningr119-5:
Done in Konin on Thursday next after the Sunday Cantate, being 22 May 1783.

On behalf of His Honour Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, against the Right Honourable Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa — Report

Appearing in person, the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn, General Royal Court Summoner, being sound, recognized that he had served authentic citation letters for the Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, of the underwritten tenor as follows:

Casimir Nałęcz Raczyński of Raczyno and Matoszyn, Starost General of Greater Poland — to you, the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa — from your estates and from all sums of money of every kind generally, had and to be had, we command: that you appear in person and peremptorily at our next Kalisz Municipal Court sessions, next to be held at the Kalisz Municipal Court, at the instance of the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, as plaintiff — who cites you — and this for the following: that you lift from the plaintiff the penalty of fourteen Polish marks, paid for the plaintiff to the exchequer of the Instigator of the Court of the Crown Tribunal of Piotrków, and that the process obtained against the plaintiff on that account from the Register of Penalties be quashed, and the plaintiff declared free — you are to comply with the citation and respond judicially.

Given in the Kalisz Municipal Court on 15 May 1783.

At the manor house of the estates of the village of Łukom, at the chair in the entrance hall, with a household youth present, on this present day, preceding the present act, set down and left notified.
app53170koningr119-7:
His Honour Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, against the Right Honourable Chełmski — Manifest

Appearing in person, the Illustrious Right Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Distinguished Order of Saint Stanislaus — coming to the aid of his estate against any harm thereto, by force of all due diligence, brings before the present court against the Right Honourable Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, a complaint in the following manner:

For, declaring: that as soon as he had been summoned by the above-mentioned Right Honourable Chełmski — for the stationing of certain men serving him and of others who, when coming to him, were untraceable — before the Land Court sessions in Konin, to have penalties imposed for the stationing, as though for a completed act of violence — immediately, explaining his innocence: that this violence, if it is shown to have been carried out by those same men, was done without his knowledge and without his mandate; and that he is only able to station two men seized at the Right Honourable Chełmski's court sessions, namely Gregorius and Thomas; while the others the arrest did not reach; so that he may not therefore appear to suffer any harm from this, he presents this present complaint, and likewise declares himself ready for inquisitions against the objections of the Right Honourable Chełmski, and to clear himself that the arrest did not reach the aforementioned men; and that he wishes to seek penalties in respect of undue harassment, with all reservations preserved.

Antoni Prusimski
app5320pozgr1181-1:
4th of March.

Done at the grounds of the estates of the village of Trąbczyn, and at
the manor sitting there, on Monday after Judica Sunday of Lent, that
is on the 29th day of the month of March, in the year of our Lord one
thousand seven hundred and eighty-four. Present the Magnificent and
Generous Eugeniusz de Gora Skarbek, castellan [written "Castellanida"]
of Inowrocław [Junivladislavia], Tomasz Zelisławski, burgrave of the
castellany of Konin, Dominik Zboina [written "Zboinatis"], sub-

Łaszkowski, Walenty Zeromski, and others; as also the Prudent
Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn, a general
ministerial of the kingdom, who proclaimed the present act.

The castellany and condescension offices, the burgraviate of Sieradz
[written "Syradien"?] and the general commissionery office of the
palatinate of Greater Poland, proceeding to the ultimate limitation,
by the castellany offices of Gostynin, the judged and commissionery
office subscribed below, at the grounds of the present estates, on
Monday after the feast of St Andrew the Apostle, that is on the first
day of the month of December of the year last past, 1783 — after the
commanded completion of the bringing of the documents, which followed
in the acts of Kalisz and Konin, on the Saturday after the feast of

[written "sub~bo"] — upon the decree of the tribunal of the kingdom
at Piotrków, given on Monday after the feast of St Francis the
Confessor, that is on the 8th day of the 8th month of the year 1782
[the day read "videlicet 8ua": the Monday after St Francis of that
year was the 7th], between the parties named below, heard in
comparition, being pronounced of its substance; upon the act of the
primal limitation, in this present place, on Monday after the feast
of the Most Holy and Undivided Trinity, that is on the sixteenth day
[one word here the editor could not read, standing for the month] of
June of the year past, 1783, by the castellany office of Gostynin,
the judged, and the cameral and territorial office of Gniezno
expeditory to the acts, on the same 20th day of the same month and
year; upon the offered and presented [written "per oblatam
porrecto"], circumscribed to the present day, determined in the acts
of the present session: condescended in the grounds specified in the
act, and there, founded on their judicial jurisdiction and by the
proclamation of the ministerial of the court, the apparitor notified
the parties [ending doubtful]; they bade those same parties proclaim
to inscribe their comparition; to whom, indeed, to the Magnificent
Kazimierz, judge territorial of Brześć in Kujawy, parent of Joanna

Przedecz [the office title and the name both doubtful in part] and to

to the Magnificent Ignacy Ensifer Przedecz and Ludwik Zakrzewski
[written "p~lr"]; then to the Magnificent Paweł and Józef, brothers
german among themselves, of Tomicki, likewise actors and cited ones,
through the same [Magnificent Jakub, parent of Józef, regent

Kunegunda de Kowalski, spouses one to the other, of Kołaczkowski,
actors and cited ones, through the Magnificent Józef Taczanowski,
regent territorial of Wieluń, in his own and others' name in person;
to the Magnificent Franciszek Tworowicz, likewise actor and cited
one, through the same; to the Most Illustrious Magnificent Antoni in
Kolno Prusimski, starost of Niszczewice, knight of the Order of St
Stanisław, cited one and actor in person; to the Most Religious
[ending doubtful] Benedykt Lubstowski, abbot [written "Ablate"] of
the convent of Ląd of the Sacred Order of the Cistercians, then the
Religious [doubtful]

Paweł Wybieralski, prior of the same convent, and the whole convent
of Ląd, to the cited ones, through the Most Honourable [written
"Rlndm"] Tesselino Malichowski, general procurator of causes of the

the bringing of documents [written "documentorium"], general ones
[written "g~lr"], elucidating the whole mass of the Prusimski and

1783, both recognised, to be reposed. Whereas the term of such a
citation, in the manner of the resolution of the tribunal's decree,
by virtue of which act the present one lapsed [word doubtful] —
therefore the said term declared last [written "lt~mo"], to be
prosecuted [ending doubtful]. In prosecuting: whereas by the
tribunal's decree now executory the bringing of the documents of the

the maternal Golinski, left by the late Magnificences Paweł and
Antoni Prusimski, sterile ones, as of the loads hanging on the same

the petitions [written "p~tibus"] through the courts or offices of
the condescension, as prescribed; and this bringing, begun in the
